purpose: AimEnergy reproducible public demo inputs and aggregate-only survey priors

field_provenance.population: Alias of village_data.csv total_population; fractional raster population estimate
field_provenance.buildings: Alias of village_data.csv building_count; not occupied households
field_provenance.all_original_village_fields: Unmodified village_data.csv values; NaN serialized null
field_provenance.candidate,existing: Curated table membership; independent from original raw village flags
field_provenance.data_flags: Derived observed-zero/missingness flags; zero is not asserted to mean nodata
field_provenance.boundary: lamwo_villages.geojson WGS84 rings; display-only Douglas-Peucker 0.0002-degree tolerance, 6 decimals

quality.nodata_status: Source has no verified per-feature nodata mask; zero counts retained and flagged, not converted to missing

limitations: No supplied metered village or mini-grid kWh outcome; existing capacity and scores are not consumption.
No exact source dates or verified licenses inferred for geospatial inputs; review upstream before public redistribution.
Simplified boundaries are for visualization, not legal, engineering, or area calculations; simplification is not topology-preserving.
Raw candidate/existing flags cover 51/28 villages; curated tables cover39/24 unique villages (25 existing records, two sharing ID5502887); original raw flags preserved.
API building observations differ from processed CSV; processed feature table consistently used.
Survey observations derive kWh from expenditure using assumed tariff250UGX/kWh; survey dates2019/2020.
445 unique households and repeated records; hhsize is inconsistent and excluded. No survey microdata or household IDs exported.
No Lamwo household observations or verified join to village table; transferred priors require field calibration.

outputs.boundaries.geojson: WGS84 FeatureCollection; Feature.id and properties.id/village_id match site IDs
outputs.survey-summary.json: Aggregate counts, weighted/unweighted means and p10/p50/p90; overall and rural/urban
outputs.catalog.json: Input hashes, field provenance, join coverage, zero/missing counts, limitations
